goals: Verify that HTTP requests to the root URL are correctly redirected to HTTPS.
Verify the functionality and 'Link' header content of the '/books' API endpoint.
activities: Make an HTTP GET request to the target's root URL using HTTP.
Verify that the HTTP request for the root URL resulted in a 301 or 308 status code.
Verify that the HTTP request for the root URL's redirection 'Location' header starts with 'https://[target]'.
Make an HTTP GET request to 'https://[target]/books?page=1'.
Verify that the HTTP GET request to '/books?page=1' resulted in a 200 status code.
Verify that the HTTP GET request to '/books?page=1' has a 'Link' header containing 'https://[target]/docs.jsonld'.
